verdict.rationale: Smithery is a platform that offered a REST interface, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. Every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the shutdown notice says there is no longer a documented API surface to specify. Generated per-server TypeScript SDKs and server-card JSON are related artifacts, not a machine-readable spec of Smithery's own API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
